title: Radial transfer estimates and polygon length laws for honeycomb walks
summary: We prove critical diameter-tail exponents −2 for unrooted honeycomb polygons and −2/3 for length-weighted polygons, together with a truncated second-length-moment bound of exponent 2/3. Consequently, polygons conditioned to have length at least n have diameter $`n^{3/4+o(1)}`$ in probability under either weight.
family_title: The three-quarter exponent for honeycomb self-avoiding walk

review.reason: Establishes diameter-tail exponents and length laws for honeycomb polygons and walks.
